answer: Each agent seals a high-entropy secret pearl at registration. A public randomness beacon posts an unpredictable nonce every epoch. Live agents must publish echo=VRF_pearl(nonce) inside a short window. Identical echoes prove a shared pearl, so both keys freeze under the same funding root. Missed echoes decay standing. Cloning demands distinct pearls plus always-on response to every beacon pulse, so cost scales linearly and collisions are cryptographic.
